newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close down as profit takers move in.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close down as profit takers move in.

text.p: 1600 GMT - Stockholm's sharemarket closed lower on Wednesday, ending a bull run of the past two consecutive days, with profit takers moving into the market.
After opening with gains and remaining higher until midday, the market slipped back in afternoon trade with a lower opening in New York pushing stocks further into the red.
* Stockholm general index closes 0.29 percent lower at 2,462.89.
* Turnover a relatively active 5.50 billion crowns.
* Blue chips Ericsson and Astra post losses as profit taking begins.
